findings.stemStart: Since 2010 a Barolo label may carry the
findings.problem: The key was the only official-sounding legal phrase and 22 characters longer than any distractor (the module's one key standout), and the distractor Sori is not a legal term anywhere, so a student could answer from shape alone.
findings.fix: Replaced Sori with Unita Geografica Aggiuntiva, the parallel term Chianti Classico and Soave use, and added one sentence to exp saying so.
findings.source: Barolo DOCG disciplinare (MGA, 2010); Chianti Classico UGA reform (2021) and Soave UGA (2019)

findings.stemStart: Fruit from a young plot, or a cru
findings.problem: Exp said Nebbiolo d'Alba excludes the Barolo and Barbaresco vineyards entirely; the current production zone includes parts of La Morra, Monforte d'Alba and Verduno, so the blanket claim can't be verified and may be wrong.
findings.fix: Exp now calls Nebbiolo d'Alba a separate and older DOC, dating from 1970 and drawn chiefly across the Roero on the far bank of the Tanaro.
findings.source: Nebbiolo d'Alba disciplinare, Regione Piemonte (October 2025 text, zone list)

findings.stemStart: North of Turin one white grape serves for
findings.problem: Exp said the Caluso passito is 'dried for years'; the grapes dry for months (through the winter) and it is the wine that then ages for years.
findings.fix: Exp now says the passito's grapes dry through the winter and the wine then ages for years.
findings.source: Erbaluce di Caluso DOCG disciplinare (Caluso Passito drying and minimum ageing)

findings.stemStart: Piedmont's traditional-method sparkling DOCG must be vintage-dated and
findings.problem: Exp placed Alta Langa 'in the hills south of the Langhe where Nebbiolo would never ripen'; Alta Langa is the upper Langa itself plus neighbouring Roero and Monferrato hills, and Nebbiolo does ripen at its lower altitudes.
findings.fix: Exp now says the vineyards sit high in the upper Langa and the neighbouring hills, where cool nights hold the acidity a base wine needs.
findings.source: Alta Langa DOCG disciplinare (zone across the Cuneo, Asti and Alessandria hills, altitude floor)

findings.stemStart: The Sesia river divides Alto Piemonte's two DOCGs
findings.problem: Distractor Lessona is a Nebbiolo DOC in the province of Biella, on the western bank of the Sesia, so a student who misreads the stem can defend it.
findings.fix: Replaced Lessona with Fara, a Nebbiolo DOC in the province of Novara on the eastern bank.
findings.source: Alto Piemonte DOC geography (Lessona in Biella, Fara in Novara)

findings.stemStart: Crossing out of Piedmont into Valle d'Aosta, Nebbiolo
findings.problem: Exp called Donnas 'the valley's Nebbiolo denomination', but Arnad-Montjovet is also Nebbiolo-based.
findings.fix: Exp now calls Donnas the valley's best-known Nebbiolo denomination.
findings.source: Valle d'Aosta DOC disciplinare (Arnad-Montjovet subzone, Nebbiolo minimum)

findings.stemStart: A white variety shared with the Swiss Valais
findings.problem: The plain entry 'arvine' graded by containment, so it also accepted 'Grosse Arvine', a distinct Valais variety.
findings.fix: Made the question ex=True and spelled out the exact forms: petite arvine, petit arvine, arvine, petite arvine grape, arvine grape and petite arvine variety. Probed with match_sa: Grosse Arvine and Cornalin now reject, and every listed form grades.
findings.source: lib.match_sa probe; Grosse Arvine as a distinct Valais variety (Wine Grapes, Robinson et al.)

findings.stemStart: Franciacorta sits on stony debris pushed into low
findings.problem: Exp said Lugana sits on clay left by 'the same glaciers'; Franciacorta's moraine is the Iseo (Oglio) glacier's, while Lugana's clay is the Garda glacier's.
findings.fix: Exp now says Lugana sits instead on the heavy clay the Garda glacier left behind.
findings.source: Glacial geology of the Iseo and Garda amphitheatres

findings.stemStart: On a Conegliano Valdobbiadene label one word introduces
findings.problem: Exp said Rive is local dialect 'rather than a legal quality tier', which contradicts the sentence before it: Rive carries its own legal rules (hand harvest, vintage, lower yield).
findings.fix: Exp now says the word itself is local dialect for a steep slope, which is exactly the ground these sites occupy.
findings.source: Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG disciplinare (Rive rules)

findings.stemStart: Volcanic hills between Soave and Vicenza grow a
findings.problem: Exp stated a production share ('tank method still accounts for the larger share of production'), a volatile figure the module's own docstring rules out.
findings.fix: Removed the share; exp now says tank-method wines are made from it as well.
findings.source: House rule: nothing volatile stated as fact

findings.stemStart: Volcanic cones rise straight out of the plain
findings.problem: Exp said the Euganean Hills are 'intrusions that never erupted through the surface'; they include submarine basalts and rhyolite and trachyte lavas and domes, so 'never erupted' is wrong.
findings.fix: Exp now says the hills are the worn remains of volcanic activity tens of millions of years old.
findings.source: Geology of the Colli Euganei (Eocene submarine volcanism, Oligocene rhyolitic and trachytic phase)

findings.stemStart: Italy's first denomination created specifically for traditional-method sparkling
findings.problem: The key 'Trento DOC' was the only option carrying its category suffix, which singled it out for a stem asking 'Which denomination?'.
findings.fix: Key shortened to 'Trento', matching the bare names of the other three.
findings.source: Item-writing standard: options of one kind and form

findings.stemStart: Pinot Bianco that stays fresh for decades comes
findings.problem: Exp said 'old bottles are released ... after at least ten years on the lees'; the Rarita lees ageing happens in tank before bottling, not in bottle.
findings.fix: Exp now says the village cooperative holds some of the wine on its fine lees in tank for a decade or more before bottling it as Rarita.
findings.source: Cantina Terlano Rarita method (extended fine-lees ageing in steel tank)

findings.stemStart: Sylvaner, Kerner and Gruner Veltliner grow up a
findings.problem: Exp called Valle Isarco 'the coldest and highest' of Alto Adige's zones; Val Venosta rivals it on both counts, and the defensible superlative is northernmost.
findings.fix: Exp now calls it the northernmost of Alto Adige's zones and among its coolest and highest.
findings.source: Alto Adige DOC subzones geography

findings.stemStart: Mozart's Don Giovanni calls for a dark, soft
findings.problem: Exp placed Isera 'south of Rovereto'; Isera lies on the right bank of the Adige, west of Rovereto.
findings.fix: Exp now says 'across the Adige from Rovereto'.
findings.source: Trentino geography (Isera and Rovereto on opposite banks of the Adige)

findings.stemStart: A nineteenth-century formula for Chianti allowed a white
findings.problem: Exp gave Canaiolo's role in Ricasoli's 1872 formula as 'structure'; Ricasoli prescribed Canaiolo to soften Sangiovese's hardness, with Sangiovese supplying perfume and vigour.
findings.fix: Exp now says Sangiovese for perfume and vigour, Canaiolo to soften it and a little Malvasia for early appeal.
findings.source: Ricasoli's 1872 letter to Professor Studiati

findings.fix: Stem now ends 'What is that Tuscan technique called?'. The id moves. check-similarity on the module is clean.

findings.fix: Stem now ends 'Which two varieties usually lead its blends?' and exp says 'by custom rather than by rule'. The id moves. check-similarity is clean.

findings.fix: Exp now reads 'in red, white and rosato'.

findings.stemStart: Which Umbrian DOCG south of Perugia is a

findings.fix: Key shortened to 'Torgiano'; exp now gives the full DOCG name, Torgiano Rosso Riserva.
findings.source: Item-writing standard: the stem must not give away the key

findings.stemStart: A bishop's servant is said to have chalked
findings.problem: The key ran 15 characters past every distractor (the module's only standout), and exp said the servant 'doubled the word twice' when he wrote it three times.
findings.fix: Key shortened to 'Est! Est!! Est!!!'. Exp now says he wrote the word three times over at Montefiascone, which is why the town completes the denomination's name.
findings.source: Est! Est!! Est!!! di Montefiascone DOC; the build's length metrics

findings.stemStart: Teramo's hills in the north of Abruzzo carry
findings.problem: The stem's 'the region's own DOCG for Montepulciano' implies it is the only one, but Tullum (Terre Tollesi), promoted in 2019, is also an Abruzzo DOCG with a Montepulciano red. The stem stays (Teramo makes the answer unique); exp now carries the correction.
findings.fix: Added to exp: the tiny Tullum zone at Tollo, promoted in 2019, is Abruzzo's other DOCG.
findings.source: Tullum DOCG recognition (2019)

findings.stemStart: A once nearly extinct Abruzzo white, now widely
findings.problem: Exp called Pecorino 'now the region's most fashionable white', a volatile trend claim stated as fact.
findings.fix: Exp now says it has since been replanted across the region.
findings.source: House rule: nothing volatile stated as fact

findings.stemStart: Molise's native red variety was nearly lost and
findings.problem: Exp used 'toward', the US form; British prose takes 'towards'.
findings.fix: Exp now reads 'climb towards the Apennine spine'.

findings.stemStart: Which pair of grapes makes the white and
findings.problem: Distractor 'Falanghina and Aglianico' names two grapes the Vesuvio DOC permits as minor shares (Falanghina in the Bianco, Aglianico in the Rosso), so a reader of 'makes' as 'is permitted in' could defend it.
findings.fix: Replaced it with 'Falanghina and Pallagrello Nero' (Pallagrello Nero is a Caserta red not permitted at Vesuvio). Exp's new first sentence says each key grape leads its colour, with smaller shares of others permitted.
findings.source: Vesuvio DOC disciplinare (Lacryma Christi Bianco and Rosso blends)

findings.stemStart: Salento's leading red carries a name usually read

findings.fix: Exp now says 'on the Ionian coast near the toe of Italy'.
findings.source: Calabrian geography (Bianco, province of Reggio Calabria, Ionian coast)

findings.fix: Exp now says 'the denomination leaving the west out'.

findings.stemStart: Under a loupe, the label of a supposed
